responsibility: Provides reusable builders for structured HIR-analysis diagnostics, centralizing the construction of detailed, context-aware error reports and suggestions for specific analysis failures: invalid ABI-sensitive variadic arguments that need explicit casts, forbidden thin-to-fat pointer casts involving dynamically sized types, and paths with the wrong number or kind of generic arguments. These files work together to give rustc_hir_analysis a focused home for assembling stable, user-facing diagnostics with tailored labels, notes, and fixes for distinct semantic errors.
